question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The flight was delayed by two hours because ____________.
options: the weather was clear and sunny
of heavy rain and poor visibility
we reached the airport on time
they served meals on the plane
answer: of heavy rain and poor visibility
explanation: Sentence mein 'because' (kyunki) hai, jo reason batata hai. Flight delay hone ka logical reason 'heavy rain aur poor visibility' hi ho sakta hai.
trick: 'because' dekho aur negative outcome (delay) ke liye negative reason dhoondho.
tip: 'Because' ke baad hamesha logical reason aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Although he studied day and night for the exam, ____________.
options: he failed to clear the cutoff
he got the first rank easily
his parents were very proud
he slept for ten hours
answer: he failed to clear the cutoff
explanation: 'Although' (halanki) contrast (ulta) meaning deta hai. Bahut mehnat ki, par result negative aaya yaani wo pass nahi hua.
trick: 'Although' wale sentence mein dono parts ka tone opposite hota hai (+ and -).
tip: 'Although' dekhte hi opposite result wala option select karo.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: If you do not submit the documents by tomorrow, ____________.
options: your application will be rejected
the manager gave you a promotion
you are going on a vacation
the documents were verified
answer: your application will be rejected
explanation: Ye ek conditional sentence hai. 'If + Present tense', toh aage aane wala result 'Will + Verb' structure mein hona chahiye. Documents na dene par rejection hi milega.
trick: 'If' + Simple Present Tense dekho, toh aage 'will/shall' + V1 aayega.
tip: 'If' condition ke baad humesha consequence ya result aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The company decided to hire more employees since ____________.
options: the workload had increased significantly
they wanted to shut down the factory
there was no work left
the employees were on a holiday
answer: the workload had increased significantly
explanation: 'Since' yahan 'kyunki' ka kaam kar raha hai. Naye logo ko hire karne ka kaaran (reason) kaam ka badhna (workload increase) hi hoga.
trick: 'since' ke pehle hiring ka action hai, toh 'since' ke baad us action ka logic dhoondho.
tip: 'Since' reason batane ke liye bhi use hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: She missed the train this morning, so ____________.
options: she had to take a cab to work
she arrived at the station early
she bought a new ticket for the same train
the train was very fast
answer: she had to take a cab to work
explanation: 'so' (isliye) result batata hai. Train miss hone ka result ye hua ki use office ke liye cab leni padi.
trick: 'so' ke baad hamesha pehle wale action ka logical effect aata hai.
tip: 'So' cause aur effect ko aapas mein connect karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Unless you apologize for your rude behavior, ____________.
options: she will not speak to you again
she thanked you for the gift
everyone will praise you
you will get a reward
answer: she will not speak to you again
explanation: 'Unless' ka matlab hai 'jab tak nahi'. Jab tak tum rude behavior ke liye maafi nahi mangoge, tab tak wo baat nahi karegi. Ye ek negative condition hai.
trick: 'Unless' negative condition hai, iske baad aane wala nateeja bhi condition par nirbhar karega.
tip: 'Unless' wale clause mein 'not' ka use nahi hota.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The students were extremely exhausted, yet ____________.
options: they continued to play football
they went to sleep immediately
they stopped working on the project
the teacher gave them a break
answer: they continued to play football
explanation: 'yet' (phir bhi) contrast show karta hai. Thak gaye the (exhausted), phir bhi khelte rahe.
trick: 'yet' aaye toh samajh jao ki action expected result (aaram karna) ke opposite hoga.
tip: 'Yet' humesha unexpected result ko dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He saved a large portion of his salary so that ____________.
options: he could buy a new house next year
he can waste it on junk food
his salary was delayed
he forgets where he kept it
answer: he could buy a new house next year
explanation: 'so that' (taaki) maqsad batata hai. Paise bachane ka maqsad aage chalkar naya ghar kharidna hai.
trick: 'so that' ke baad hamesha 'can', 'could', 'may' ya 'might' wala clause dhoondho.
tip: 'So that' purpose ya intention (irada) show karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Despite the heavy traffic on the highway, ____________.
options: we managed to reach the venue on time
we were late for the meeting
the cars were moving very slowly
the road was completely blocked
answer: we managed to reach the venue on time
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast dikhata hai. Traffic tha, uske bawajood time par pahunch gaye.
trick: 'Despite' wale questions mein ek problem hogi aur doosra uska positive resolution hoga.
tip: 'Despite' ke sath 'of' ka use kabhi nahi karna chahiye.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The teacher praised the student highly because ____________.
options: he had completed the assignment perfectly
he was absent for three days
he forgot his textbook at home
he was making noise in the class
answer: he had completed the assignment perfectly
explanation: Tareef (praise) karne ka reason positive hi hoga. Assignment perfectly complete karna ek positive action hai.
trick: First half positive (praised) hai aur beech mein 'because' hai, toh option bhi positive hoga.
tip: Positive action ka reason hamesha positive hi nikalta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: As soon as the match ended, ____________.
options: the crowd started cheering loudly
the players will start playing
the umpire cancels the game
it was raining yesterday
answer: the crowd started cheering loudly
explanation: 'As soon as' (jaise hi) dikhata hai ki ek action ke turant baad doosra hua. Tense match karna zaroori hai (Past Tense).
trick: 'As soon as' ke sath dono clauses ka tense generally same hota hai (ended -> started).
tip: 'As soon as' humesha immediate action ko dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Not only did she bake a delicious cake, ____________.
options: but she also decorated it beautifully
but she eats it alone
and she throws it away
but also she forgot the recipe
answer: but she also decorated it beautifully
explanation: 'Not only' ke sath hamesha 'but also' ka pair (joda) banta hai. Dono actions positive sense mein add ho rahe hain.
trick: Sentence mein 'Not only' dekho toh options mein seedhe 'but also' wala clause dhoondho.
tip: 'Not only... but also' ka pair sath chalta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He walked out of the room quietly in order to ____________.
options: avoid waking up the sleeping baby
make a lot of noise
fight with his brother
start dancing loudly
answer: avoid waking up the sleeping baby
explanation: 'in order to' (taaki) action ka reason batata hai. Chupchap room se bahar aane ka kaaran baby ko na jagana hai.
trick: 'in order to' ke baad hamesha Verb ki 1st form aati hai jo logical reason bataye.
tip: 'In order to' + V1 humesha purpose ko batata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Either you pay the electricity bill today, ____________.
options: or they will disconnect the connection
nor they will cut the wire
and you will get a discount
but the bill is high
answer: or they will disconnect the connection
explanation: 'Either' ke sath 'or' aata hai. Ye options deta hai. Ya toh bill pay karo, ya connection katne ke liye ready raho.
trick: 'Either' dekhte hi options mein 'or' word ko spot karo. Ye fixed jodi hai.
tip: 'Either... or' do options mein se ek ko choose karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The shopkeeper offered a huge discount, therefore ____________.
options: many customers bought the new products
no one entered the shop
he increased the prices
the shop was closed
answer: many customers bought the new products
explanation: 'therefore' (isliye) result batata hai. Bada discount dene ka logical result yahi hoga ki sales badh jayengi.
trick: 'Therefore' se pehle action/cause hai, toh baad mein uska effect aayega (sales increase).
tip: 'Therefore' cause aur effect ko aapas mein link karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: She was so tired from the long journey that ____________.
options: she fell asleep as soon as she reached home
she decided to run a marathon
she went to a late-night party
she started cleaning the entire house
answer: she fell asleep as soon as she reached home
explanation: 'so... that' (itni... ki) extreme level aur uske result ko batata hai. Itni thak gayi thi ki ghar pahunchte hi so gayi.
trick: 'so + adjective + that' aaye toh aage us condition ka natural result dhoondho.
tip: 'So... that' hamesha ek degree aur uska result show karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: We had to cancel our weekend trip to the mountains because ____________.
options: of a sudden landslide blocking the roads
the hotel was luxurious
we had too much free time
everyone was very excited
answer: of a sudden landslide blocking the roads
explanation: Trip cancel hone ka koi solid aur negative reason hona chahiye. Pahaadon (mountains) mein landslide hona logical reason hai.
trick: Cancel (negative) + because + negative situation. Options mein matching tone dekho.
tip: Negative result ka kaaran generally negative hi hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: I will not attend the farewell party unless ____________.
options: my best friend comes with me
you give me extra work
the party is boring
the food is completely tasteless
answer: my best friend comes with me
explanation: 'Unless' condition lagata hai. Main party mein nahi jaunga, jab tak ki mera best friend mere sath na aaye.
trick: Sentence ka matlab nikalo: 'Agar friend nahi aaya, toh main nahi jaunga'.
tip: 'Unless' ka basic meaning 'if not' ke jaisa hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Having finished all his pending homework, ____________.
options: Rahul finally went out to play with his friends
Rahul was scolded by his teacher
Rahul has a lot of work to do
Rahul forgot his school bag
answer: Rahul finally went out to play with his friends
explanation: 'Having + V3' (perfect participle) batata hai ki ek kaam pura hone par doosra shuru hua. Homework khatam karke khelne jana logical hai.
trick: 'Having + V3' ke baad comma lagkar us subject ka naam aayega jisne kaam kiya hai.
tip: Perfect participle ek action ke poora hone ko darshata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Neither the manager nor the employees ____________.
options: were aware of the new policy changes
was working properly
is going to the market yesterday
has complete the task
answer: were aware of the new policy changes
explanation: 'Neither... nor' rule mein helping verb hamesha us subject ke hisaab se lagti hai jo verb ke paas ho ('employees' plural hai toh 'were' lagega).
trick: 'nor' ke baad wale noun 'employees' (plural) ko dekho aur plural verb wala option chuno.
tip: 'Neither... nor' mein verb second subject ke according hoti hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The team lost the championship match even though ____________.
options: they had practiced rigorously for months
the weather was completely fine
they refused to play together
the stadium was fully packed
answer: they had practiced rigorously for months
explanation: 'Even though' (bhale hi) contrast dikhata hai. Bahut mehnat aur practice karne ke baad bhi team haar gayi, ye ek logical contrast hai.
trick: 'Even though' dekhte hi pehle part (lost) ka opposite logic (practiced hard) dhoondho.
tip: 'Even though' hamesha unexpected result ko highlight karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Since the bridge is under construction, ____________.
options: we will have to take an alternative route
the workers are sleeping peacefully
the cars are driving very fast
the river is flowing smoothly
answer: we will have to take an alternative route
explanation: 'Since' yahan ek reason batata hai. Kyunki bridge ban raha hai, isliye humein doosra rasta (alternative route) lena padega.
trick: 'Since' ke baad ek problem hai, toh aage us problem ka logical solution dhoondho.
tip: 'Since' cause aur effect batane ke liye bhi aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: She refused to accept the job offer because ____________.
options: the salary package was too low
she wanted to start working immediately
the office was very close to her house
she was selected for the role
answer: the salary package was too low
explanation: Job offer thukrane (refuse karne) ka reason hamesha negative hona chahiye. Salary ka kam hona iska sabse logical kaaran hai.
trick: 'refused' ek negative word hai, aur 'because' ke baad uska negative kaaran hi aayega.
tip: Negative action ka reason zyada tar negative hi hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He was walking carefully on the wet floor lest ____________.
options: he should slip and fall down
he might reach the room quickly
he will slip and fall
he could run faster
answer: he should slip and fall down
explanation: 'Lest' ka matlab hota hai 'aisa na ho ki'. Iske sath grammar rule ke hisaab se hamesha 'should' ka use hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'lest' dikhe toh aage aankh band karke 'should' wala option dhundho.
tip: 'Lest' ke sath hamesha 'should' ka pair banta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: As long as you follow the instructions properly, ____________.
options: you will not face any difficulty
the machine broke down immediately
you had to pay a heavy fine
everyone will laugh at you
answer: you will not face any difficulty
explanation: 'As long as' ek shart (condition) batata hai. Jab tak tum rules follow karoge, koi problem nahi aayegi. Ye ek positive condition hai.
trick: 'As long as' + positive action (follow instructions) aaye toh nateeja bhi positive hoga.
tip: 'As long as' ek samay seema ya condition ko darshata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The government announced a tax holiday so that ____________.
options: small businesses could recover from the loss
the rich people become more greedy
the citizens will stop paying taxes
the ministers can go on a vacation
answer: small businesses could recover from the loss
explanation: 'So that' (taaki) intention ya purpose batata hai. Tax chhoot dene ka maqsad chote businesses ko nuksaan se ubarna hai.
trick: 'so that' ke baad purpose dikhane ke liye 'can', 'could' ya 'may' wala option chuno.
tip: 'So that' hamesha kisi action ka maqsad (purpose) batata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Hardly had I stepped out of my house when ____________.
options: it started raining heavily
then I forgot my umbrella
than the bus arrived
but the door was locked
answer: it started raining heavily
explanation: 'Hardly' ke sath conjunction 'when' ka use hota hai aur ye immediate past action ko dikhata hai. Main nikla hi tha ki barish hone lagi.
trick: 'Hardly/Scarcely' wale sentence mein options ke andar conjunction 'when' wala part dhoondho.
tip: 'Hardly' aur 'Scarcely' ke sath hamesha 'when' ka pair banta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: You must submit your project by Friday, otherwise ____________.
options: marks will be deducted from your final grade
the teacher will reward you
you can submit it next month
the school will remain closed
answer: marks will be deducted from your final grade
explanation: 'Otherwise' (warna) warning ya negative consequence dikhata hai. Time par project na dene ka result marks katna hi hoga.
trick: 'otherwise' aaye toh uske baad ek nuksaan (warning/threat) wala nateeja dhoondho.
tip: 'Otherwise' hamesha ek shart ka negative result dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: No sooner did the train arrive at the station than ____________.
options: the passengers rushed to board it
when the guard blew the whistle
the driver stops the engine
then everyone started clapping
answer: the passengers rushed to board it
explanation: 'No sooner... than' ka matlab hai 'jaise hi... waise hi'. Jaise hi train aayi, log usme chadne ke liye bhage.
trick: 'No sooner' wale question mein 'than' wala option chuno, aur action natural hona chahiye.
tip: 'No sooner' ke sath hamesha 'than' aata hai, 'then' ya 'when' nahi.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He is saving money every month with a view to ____________.
options: purchasing a new car next year
buy a new house tomorrow
paying his old electricity bills
he can travel the world
answer: purchasing a new car next year
explanation: 'With a view to' ka matlab hai kisi khaas maqsad se. Grammar ke mutabiq is phrase ke baad hamesha Verb ki (ing) form yaani Gerund aati hai.
trick: 'with a view to' ke theek baad verb + 'ing' (gerund) wala option select karo.
tip: 'With a view to' aur 'looking forward to' ke baad V4 (V1+ing) aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Not only is she an excellent singer, ____________.
options: but she is also a talented dancer
and she plays guitar well
but also she hates music
therefore she earns a lot
answer: but she is also a talented dancer
explanation: Sentence 'Not only' se shuru hua hai, toh iska doosra hissa 'but also' se judega. Dono khoobiyan (qualities) positive honi chahiye.
trick: 'Not only' dekho toh options mein 'but (subject) also' ka fixed pattern dhoondho.
tip: 'Not only... but also' mein parts of speech parallel hone chahiye.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The meeting was postponed indefinitely owing to ____________.
options: the sudden illness of the managing director
the snacks being very tasty
everyone arriving on time
the bright sunny weather
answer: the sudden illness of the managing director
explanation: 'Owing to' (ke kaaran) ek prepositional phrase hai jo reason batata hai. Meeting delay hone ka valid negative reason bimari (illness) hi hai.
trick: 'Owing to' delay ka kaaran batata hai. Delay (negative) ke liye negative cause dhoondho.
tip: 'Owing to' ka meaning 'because of' ya 'due to' ke barabar hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Provided that you return it in good condition, ____________.
options: you can borrow my camera for the trip
I will sell this car to you
you broke the glass yesterday
you should pay the full price
answer: you can borrow my camera for the trip
explanation: 'Provided that' (is shart par) condition lagata hai. Agar cheez sahi salamat wapas karoge, tabhi udhaar le sakte ho.
trick: 'Provided that' + shart (return good condition) = positive permission (can borrow).
tip: 'Provided that' ka matlab 'only if' (sirf agar) hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Despite working in the same office for five years, ____________.
options: they hardly know anything about each other
they are best friends now
everyone respects them a lot
they got promoted together
answer: they hardly know anything about each other
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast dikhata hai. 5 saal sath kaam karne ke baad bhi wo ek doosre ko nahi jante, ye ek ulta (unexpected) result hai.
trick: 'Despite' wale sentence mein expected result ke bilkul opposite wala option chuno.
tip: 'Despite' ke sath kabhi bhi 'of' preposition ka use nahi hota.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: If I had known about your arrival, ____________.
options: I would have come to the airport to pick you up
I will cook dinner for you
I would come to the station
I am going to the market
answer: I would have come to the airport to pick you up
explanation: Ye third conditional sentence hai ('If + Past Perfect'). Rule ke mutabiq, iske baad wale clause mein 'would have + V3' aana zaroori hai.
trick: 'If + had + V3' dekhte hi options mein 'would have + V3' dhundhna shuru kar do.
tip: Third conditional un-real past situations (pachtawa) ko darshata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He could not understand the lecture as ____________.
options: the professor was speaking too fast
he scored top marks in it
the classroom was very silent
the notes were clearly printed
answer: the professor was speaking too fast
explanation: 'As' yahan 'kyunki' (because) ka kaam kar raha hai. Lecture samajh na aane ka sabse sahi aur logical kaaran teacher ka tez bolna hai.
trick: Samajh nahi aaya (negative result) -> 'as' -> aage aane wala kaaran bhi problem wala hoga.
tip: Conjunction 'As' reason aur time dono batane ke liye use hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Unless the government takes immediate action, ____________.
options: the pollution levels will continue to rise
the city will become very clean
people will plant more trees
everyone was happy
answer: the pollution levels will continue to rise
explanation: 'Unless' ek negative shart (condition) hai (Jab tak ki nahi). Jab tak action nahi liya jayega, pollution ka badhna jaari rahega.
trick: 'Unless' ke action ke na hone par kya bura result aayega, option mein wahi dhoondho.
tip: 'Unless' wale hisse (clause) mein 'not' ka prayog nahi kiya jata.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The food at the restaurant was so spicy that ____________.
options: we had to order cold drinks immediately
we ordered another plate of it
the chef was given an award
it was completely tasteless
answer: we had to order cold drinks immediately
explanation: 'So... that' (itna... ki). Khana itna teekha (spicy) tha ki turant cold drink mangwani padi. Ye effect bilkul logical hai.
trick: 'so + adjective + that' aaye toh aage us situation ko balance karne wala natural action dhoondho.
tip: 'So... that' hamesha ek extreme degree aur uska nateeja batata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Even if it rains heavily tomorrow, ____________.
options: the marathon will take place as scheduled
the match will be cancelled
we will stay at home all day
the roads will be flooded
answer: the marathon will take place as scheduled
explanation: 'Even if' (bhale hi) batata hai ki ek extreme condition ka main event par koi asar nahi hoga. Bhale barish ho, marathon apne tay samay par hogi.
trick: 'Even if' wale sentences mein nateeja wahi rehta hai jo pehle se tay ho, condition kuch bhi ho.
tip: 'Even if' strong contrast ya majboot irade ko darshata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The manager praised the team members, for ____________.
options: they had completed the project before the deadline
they were late to the office
they ignored the client's emails
they took an unapproved leave
answer: they had completed the project before the deadline
explanation: Yahan 'for' ka use conjunction (kyunki) ki tarah hua hai. Manager ne tareef ki kyunki unhone project time se pehle pura kar liya tha.
trick: Comma (,) ke baad 'for' aaye toh wo reason batata hai. Tareef (praise) ka reason hamesha positive dhoondho.
tip: Conjunction 'for' ka meaning aur kaam 'because' ki tarah hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He decided to wear a thick winter coat because ____________.
options: it was freezing outside
the sun was shining brightly
he wanted to go swimming
his friends told him a joke
answer: it was freezing outside
explanation: 'Because' (kyunki) reason batata hai. Mota coat pehanne ka logical reason bahar bahut thand hona (freezing) hi hoga.
trick: 'Because' ke theek pehle wale action (wear thick coat) ka natural kaaran options mein dhoondho.
tip: 'Because' ke baad hamesha kaaran (reason) aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The movie received excellent reviews from critics, but ____________.
options: it was a massive flop at the box office
it won several prestigious awards
the actors performed brilliantly
the director was highly praised
answer: it was a massive flop at the box office
explanation: 'But' (lekin) contrast show karta hai. Reviews acche the (positive), lekin result ulta hua yaani box office par pit gayi (negative).
trick: 'But' ke pehle positive baat ho toh uske baad negative point aayega.
tip: 'But' hamesha opposite ideas ko jodne ka kaam karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: She forgot her wallet at home, so ____________.
options: she had to borrow money from her colleague
she bought an expensive dress
the store was completely empty
her bag was very heavy
answer: she had to borrow money from her colleague
explanation: 'So' (isliye) nateeja ya effect batata hai. Wallet ghar bhoolne ka result ye hoga ki use kisi se paise udhaar lene padenge.
trick: 'So' dekhte hi samajh jao ki pichli problem ka aage kya asar padega.
tip: 'So' hamesha cause ke baad effect batane ke liye aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: If the company offers me a better salary package, ____________.
options: I will definitely accept the job offer
they will close the office tomorrow
I have rejected the previous offer
the manager was very angry
answer: I will definitely accept the job offer

he slept without even eating his dinner
he went to a late night party with friends
he started studying for his mathematics exam
answer: he slept without even eating his dinner
explanation: 'So... that' (itna... ki) extreme condition batata hai. Itni thakan (tiredness) thi ki wo bina khana khaye hi so gaya.
trick: 'so tired' ek extreme physical state hai. Iska direct logical effect bina khaye so jana hoga.
tip: 'So... that' hamesha extreme level aur uske turant asar ko dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Unless the doctor arrives at the hospital immediately, ____________.
options: the patient's condition will become very critical
the nurses will go home early
the patient will completely recover on his own
the hospital staff will organize a party
answer: the patient's condition will become very critical
explanation: 'Unless' (jab tak ki nahi) shart batata hai. Jab tak doctor turant nahi aayega, patient ki halat aur kharab (critical) ho jayegi.
trick: 'Unless' wale condition ke na poore hone par kya bura asar padega, option mein wahi dhoondho.
tip: 'Unless' ka use negative condition ko express karne ke liye hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Despite facing many financial problems in his childhood, ____________.
options: he completely gave up on his studies
he started begging on the city streets
he successfully completed his higher education
he never tried to find a good job
answer: he successfully completed his higher education
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast dikhata hai. Paise ki kami (financial problems) ke bawajood achi padhai puri karna ek positive aur unexpected achievement hai.
trick: Problem ke bawajood (Despite) ek badi success mili hogi, isliye positive outcome wala option chuno.
tip: 'Despite' hamesha bina 'of' ke use hota hai aur contrast dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: She locked the front door carefully so that ____________.
options: no thief could enter the house at night
she could throw the keys away
the fresh air could come inside the room
her friends could easily come in
answer: no thief could enter the house at night
explanation: 'So that' (taaki) maqsad batata hai. Darwaza carefully lock karne ka maqsad yahi hoga ki koi chor andar na aa sake.
trick: 'so that' ke theek baad action ka reason ya fayda (can/could ke sath) dhoondho.
tip: 'So that' humesha kisi action ka main purpose (maqsad) show karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Not only did the manager shout at the employees, ____________.
options: but he also threatened to fire them from the job
and he gave them a promotion
but also he apologized later
so he increased their salary
answer: but he also threatened to fire them from the job
explanation: 'Not only' ke sath 'but also' ka pair (joda) banta hai. Dono actions same tone (negative yahan par) ke hone chahiye - chillana aur job se nikalne ki dhamki dena.
trick: Sentence 'Not only' se shuru ho, toh doosre part mein 'but also' ka pattern dhoondho.
tip: 'Not only... but also' hamesha do similar tone wale actions ko jodta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Rohan is extremely rich and successful, yet ____________.
options: he lives a very simple and humble life
he owns multiple luxury cars in his garage
he wears very expensive designer clothes
he travels around the world every month
answer: he lives a very simple and humble life
explanation: 'Yet' (phir bhi) contrast show karta hai. Bahut ameer aur successful hone ke bawajood uski life simple hai, ye ek unexpected baat (contrast) hai.
trick: Amiri (Richness) ke sath 'yet' laga ho, toh aage uski simplicity ya garibi jaisi baat dhoondho.
tip: 'Yet' ek conjunction hai jo hamesha opposite idea ko jodata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: As soon as the cricket match started, ____________.
options: it began to rain heavily on the ground
the players went back to their homes
the umpire declared the winner
everyone went to sleep quickly
answer: it began to rain heavily on the ground
explanation: 'As soon as' (jaise hi) dikhata hai ki ek event ke turant baad doosra event hua. Match shuru hote hi barish hone lagi, ye ek natural interruption hai.
trick: 'As soon as' do kamon ke beech koi gap nahi chhodta. Action ke theek baad ka interruption chuno.
tip: 'As soon as' hamesha immediate next action ya reaction ko batata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Since the markets are closed today for the festival, ____________.
options: we will have to buy the vegetables tomorrow
we bought all the fresh fruits easily
the shops are very crowded right now
the shopkeepers are earning a lot of money
answer: we will have to buy the vegetables tomorrow
explanation: 'Since' yahan reason batata hai. Market band hone ki wajah se sabziyan kal kharidni padengi, ye bilkul sahi logic hai.
trick: Cause 'market closed' hai, toh uska effect yahi hoga ki shopping aaj nahi, baad mein hogi.
tip: Conjunction 'Since' ka use reason (kyunki) batane ke liye bhi hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: You can use my laptop for your college project provided that ____________.
options: you do not delete any of my important files
you break its screen today
you install a dangerous virus in it
you never return it to me
answer: you do not delete any of my important files
explanation: 'Provided that' (basarte / is shart par) condition lagata hai. Laptop use karne ki shart yahi hogi ki koi zaroori file delete na ki jaye.
trick: 'Provided that' ke baad ek aisi positive shart (condition) dhoondho jo owner ko nuksan na pahunchaye.
tip: 'Provided that' kisi action ko allow karne ke liye condition rakhta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: We must leave for the railway station right now, otherwise ____________.
options: we will miss our train to Mumbai
we will reach there very early
the train will wait for us
the station master will award us
answer: we will miss our train to Mumbai
explanation: 'Otherwise' (warna) ek warning aur uska nateeja batata hai. Abhi nahi nikle toh train chhut jayegi.
trick: 'otherwise' aaye toh uske baad ek nuksaan (loss/miss) wala nateeja dhoondho.
tip: 'Otherwise' hamesha condition na manne par negative result dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: No sooner had the teacher entered the classroom than ____________.
options: all the students stood up to greet her
the bell rang for the final dispersal
when everyone started making loud noises
then the principal gave a long speech
answer: all the students stood up to greet her
explanation: 'No sooner... than' ka matlab hai 'jaise hi... waise hi'. Teacher ke class mein aate hi bacchon ka khade hokar wish karna natural reaction hai.
trick: 'No sooner' wale sentence mein 'than' se shuru hone wala logical action (stood up) dhoondho.
tip: 'No sooner' ke baad hamesha 'than' aata hai, 'when' ya 'then' nahi.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: He joined a special coaching class in order to ____________.
options: improve his communication skills in English
waste his time and money completely
disturb the other serious students
forget whatever he had learned earlier
answer: improve his communication skills in English
explanation: 'In order to' (taaki) maqsad batata hai. Coaching join karne ka main purpose skills ko sudharna (improve karna) hi hota hai.
trick: 'in order to' ke theek baad verb ki first form (V1) aur uske piche ka positive fayda dhoondho.
tip: 'In order to' ek specific purpose ya goal ko highlight karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Even though the price of the smartphone was very high, ____________.
options: many people stood in line to buy it
nobody wanted to even look at it
the company stopped producing it completely
it was heavily discounted online
answer: many people stood in line to buy it
explanation: 'Even though' (bhale hi) unexpected asar (contrast) dikhata hai. Mehnga hone ke bawajood logo ka line mein lagkar kharidna ek contrast hai.
trick: Price high (negative aspect) + 'Even though' = Log fir bhi kharid rahe hain (Positive action).
tip: 'Even though' hamesha aam umeed ke bilkul opposite result dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: The cricket match was officially cancelled owing to ____________.
options: the wet outfield and continuous heavy rainfall
the players scoring too many runs
the large crowd cheering very loudly
the perfect sunny weather condition
answer: the wet outfield and continuous heavy rainfall
explanation: 'Owing to' (ke kaaran) reason batata hai. Match cancel hone ka logical kaaran gila maidan (wet outfield) aur barish hi hai.
trick: 'Owing to' delay ya cancel ka kaaran batata hai, isliye options mein negative weather condition dhoondho.
tip: 'Owing to' aur 'due to' dono reason (kaaran) batane ke liye use hote hain.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: While some people prefer to read printed books, ____________.
options: others like reading on their electronic devices
they also enjoy watching movies on television
the library has very strict rules
books are made from recycled paper
answer: others like reading on their electronic devices
explanation: 'While' (jabki) do opposite preferences ko compare karta hai. Kuch log paper books pasand karte hain, jabki dusre electronic devices (e-books) par padhna.
trick: 'While some...' dekhte hi options mein 'others...' wala comparison dhoondho.
tip: 'While' do alag-alag aadat ya vichaaron (opinions) ki tulna karta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the most appropriate phrase/clause from the options to complete the given sentence meaningfully. || Question: Hardly had the chief guest started his speech when ____________.
options: the microphone suddenly stopped working
than everyone started clapping for him
then he finished speaking quickly
the audience is listening carefully
answer: the microphone suddenly stopped working
explanation: 'Hardly... when' ek action start hote hi usme hone wale interruption ko dikhata hai. Speech shuru hote hi mic ka kharab hona immediate event hai.
trick: 'Hardly' ke sath sentence ho toh option mein 'when' ya simple past tense wala interruption dhoondho.
tip: 'Hardly' aur 'Scarcely' ke sath conjunction hamesha 'when' aata hai.
